descriptionEn: A duplex with an area of 200m² is offered for rent in Pejton, Prishtina.

The duplex is designed in a modern style with quality materials, offering a comfortable and functional environment. The space includes a spacious living room with a decorative fireplace, a kitchen fully equipped with contemporary appliances and a dining area, three bedrooms and three bathrooms fitted with luxury elements, including a sauna and jacuzzi.
Large windows provide abundant natural light and an open view over the city, while the duplex layout with a modern staircase creates a good separation of spaces.
The property also offers a dedicated garage or parking space.
The location is very favourable, near institutions and shopping centres, in one of the most sought-after areas of Prishtina.
